                function object(objectId) {
                    if (document.getElementById && document.getElementById(objectId)) {
                        return document.getElementById(objectId);
                    } else if (document.all && document.all(objectId)) {
                        return document.all(objectId);
                    } else if (document.layers && document.layers[objectId]) {
                        return document.layers[objectId];
                    } else {
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                // JAVASCRIPT COOKIES CODE: for getting and setting user viewing preferences
                var cookies = {
                    create: function (name, value, days2expire, path) {
                        var date = new Date();
                        date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days2expire * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                        var expires = date.toUTCString();
                        document.cookie = name + '=' + value + ';' + 'expires=' + expires + ';domain=.tvtropes.org;' + 'path=' + path + ';';
                    },
										createWithExpire: function(name, value, expires, path) {
												document.cookie = name + '=' + value + ';' + 'expires=' + expires + ';domain=.tvtropes.org;' + 'path=' + path + ';';
										},
                    read: function (name) {
                        var cookie_value = "",
                            current_cookie = "",
                            name_expr = name + "=",
                            all_cookies = document.cookie.split(';'),
                            n = all_cookies.length;

                        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            current_cookie = all_cookies[i].trim();
                            if (current_cookie.indexOf(name_expr) === 0) {
                                cookie_value = current_cookie.substring(name_expr.length, current_cookie.length);
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        return cookie_value;
                    },
                    update: function (name, val) {
                        this.create(name, val, 300, "/");
                    },
                    remove: function (name) {
                        //delete cookie with and without domain setting
                        document.cookie = name + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; domain=.tvtropes.org; path=/;";
                        document.cookie = name + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/;";
                    }
                };

                // show app promo banner
                function show_promo(){
                    var logged_in = false;

                    // Check for the different possible cookies set by closeBanner()
                    var banner_cookie_logged_in = cookies.read('app-announcement-banner-logged-in');
                    var banner_cookie_guest = cookies.read('app-announcement-banner-guest');

                    if(logged_in){
                        document.body.classList.remove('app-promo');
                        if(banner_cookie_logged_in){
                            document.body.classList.add('footer-app-promo');
                        }else{
                            document.body.classList.remove('footer-app-promo');
                        }
                    }else{
                        document.body.classList.remove('footer-app-promo');
                        if(banner_cookie_guest){
                            document.body.classList.remove('app-promo');
                        }else{
                            document.body.classList.add('app-promo');
                        }
                    }
                }

                function updateUserPrefs() {
                    //GENERAL: detect and set browser, if not cookied (will be treated like a user-preference and added to the #user-pref element)
                    if( !cookies.read('user-browser') ){
                        var broswer = '';

                        if(navigator.userAgent.match(/iPhone/i) || navigator.userAgent.match(/iPod/i) ){
                            browser = 'iOS';
                        } else if (/Opera[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
                            browser = 'opera';
                        } else if (/MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
                            browser = 'MSIE';
                        } else if (/Navigator[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
                            browser = 'netscape';
                        } else if (/Chrome[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
                            browser = 'chrome';
                        } else if (/Safari[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
                            browser = 'safari';
                            /Version[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);
                            browserVersion = new Number(RegExp.$1);
                        } else if (/Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
                            browser = 'firefox';
                        } else {
                            browser = 'internet_explorer';
                        }
                        cookies.create('user-browser',browser,1,'/');
                        document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('browser-' + browser);
                    } else {
                        document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('browser-' + cookies.read('user-browser'));
                    }

                    //update user preference settings based on their database settings
                    var logged_in = false;
                    
                    if(logged_in == false) {
                        if(cookies.read('wide-load') !== '') document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('wide-load');
                        if(cookies.read('night-vision') !== '') document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('night-vision');
                        if(cookies.read('sticky-header') !== '') document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('sticky-header');
                        if(cookies.read('show-spoilers') !== '') document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('show-spoilers');
                        if(cookies.read('highlight-links') !== '') document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('highlight-links');
                    } else {
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('wide-load');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('mono-font');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('night-vision');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('sticky-header');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('show-spoilers');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('tvtropes-editor-on');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('folders-open');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('lefthand-sidebar');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('highlight-links');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('forum-gingerbread');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('hide-likes-articles');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('hide-likes-posts');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('shared-avatars');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('stop-auto-play-video');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('hide-laconic-hover');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('show-namespaces');
                    }
                        
                    //desktop view on mobile
                    if (cookies.read('desktop-on-mobile') !== ''){
                        document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('desktop-on-mobile');

                        var viewport = document.querySelector("meta[name=viewport]");
                        viewport.setAttribute('content', 'width=1000');
                    }

                    if (logged_in) {
                        if (1) cookies.remove('stop-auto-play-video');
                        else if (0) cookies.create('stop-auto-play-video','true',300,'/');
                    }

                    //updates element
                    if(cookies.read('stop-auto-play-video') !== '') document.getElementById('user-prefs').classList.add('stop-auto-play-video');
                }

                function updateDesktopPrefs() {
                    var logged_in = false;

                    if(logged_in == false) {
                        if(cookies.read('wide-load') !== '') document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-wideload').classList.add('active');
                        if(cookies.read('night-vision') !== '') document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-nightvision').classList.add('active');
                        if(cookies.read('sticky-header') !== '') document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-stickyheader').classList.add('active');
                        if(cookies.read('show-spoilers') !== '') document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-showspoilers').classList.add('active');
                    } else {
                        if (false) document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-wideload').classList.add('active');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-nightvision').classList.add('active');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-stickyheader').classList.add('active');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle-showspoilers').classList.add('active');
                    }
                }

                function updateMobilePrefs() {
                    var logged_in = false;

                    if(logged_in == false) {
                        if(cookies.read('highlight-links') !== '') document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-highlightlinks').classList.add('active');
                        if(cookies.read('night-vision') !== '') document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-nightvision').classList.add('active');
                        if(cookies.read('sticky-header') !== '') document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-stickyheader').classList.add('active');
                        if(cookies.read('show-spoilers') !== '') document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-showspoilers').classList.add('active'); 
                    } else {
                        if (false) document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-showspoilers').classList.add('active');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-nightvision').classList.add('active');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-stickyheader').classList.add('active');
                        if (false) document.getElementById('mobile-toggle-highlightlinks').classList.add('active');
                    }
                }

                function is_mobile() {
	                if(document.body.clientWidth && document.body.clientWidth<=768) return true;

    // Detect if browser is Safari
    function is_ios_safari(){
        var ua = navigator.userAgent;
        return /iP(hone|ad|od)/.test(ua) && /Safari/.test(ua) && !/CriOS|FxiOS|OPiOS|EdgiOS/.test(ua);
    }

    // Detect OS only
    function get_mobile_type(){
        var userAgent = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera;

        if(/iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(userAgent)){
            return "iOS";
        } else if(/Android/i.test(userAgent)){
            return "Android";
        } else {
            return "Other";
        }
    }

    // Get current page path for deep linking (use tvtropes:// custom scheme)
    var deepLink = "tvtropes://" + window.location.pathname.replace(/^\//, '');

    // App store URLs
    var appStoreUrls = {
        iOS: "https://apps.apple.com/app/6738365737",
        Android: "https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.tvtropes.app"
    };

    var promo_link = document.getElementById("promo-app-link");
    var os = get_mobile_type();

    if(os === "iOS" && is_ios_safari()){
        // Safari iOS — rely on native Smart App Banner, hide custom one
        document.body.classList.remove("app-promo");
    }
    else{
        // Handle click with smart fallback for all other browsers
        promo_link.addEventListener("click", function(e){
            e.preventDefault();

            var fallbackUrl = appStoreUrls[os] || appStoreUrls.iOS;
            var appOpened = false;

            // Set up fallback to app store
            var fallbackTimeout = setTimeout(function(){
                // If we're still here after 1.5s, app probably isn't installed
                if(!appOpened && document.visibilityState !== "hidden"){
                    window.location.href = fallbackUrl;
                }
            }, 1500);

            // Listen for page visibility change (app opened successfully)
            var handleVisibilityChange = function(){
                if(document.visibilityState === "hidden"){
                    appOpened = true;
                    clearTimeout(fallbackTimeout);
                }
            };
            document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibilityChange);

            // Clean up listener after attempt
            setTimeout(function(){
                document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibilityChange);
            }, 2000);

            // Attempt to open the app
            window.location.href = deepLink;
        });
    }

            <p><!--
-->
<!--
-->
<!-- This page has been alphabetized. Please add new examples in the correct order. Thanks!-->
<!--
-->
<!--
-->
<!-- Image selected per Image Pickin' thread: https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/posts.php?discussion=1574365977049153600-->
<!-- Previous thread: https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/posts.php?discussion=avoimkpluikmpn8pa3765bip-->
<!-- Please do not change or remove without starting a new thread.-->
<!--
-->
</p><p></p><div class="quoteright" style="width:227px;"><a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Film/Underworld2003" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Film/Underworld2003" data-format="W1tGaWxtL1VuZGVyd29ybGQyMDAzIGh0dHBzOi8vc3RhdGljLnR2dHJvcGVzLm9yZy9wbXdpa2kvcHViL2ltYWdlcy9kaWFnb25hbF9jdXRfMS5wbmddXQ=="><div class="lazy_load_img_box" style="padding-top:179.74%"><img src="https://static.tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pub/images/diagonal_cut_1.png" class="embeddedimage" border="0" alt="Diagonal Cut (trope)" width="227" height="408"></div></a></div>
<div class="acaptionright" style="width:227px;"> Now that's what I call a <em><a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Pun" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Pun" data-format="W1t7e1B1bn19IHNwbGl0dGluZ11d">splitting</a></em> headache!</div>
<!--
-->
<div class="indent"><em>"Aaaand, the split... Any minute now. Damn that must have been a smooth cut, he ain't falling... apart."</em>
<div class="indent">— <strong>Dr. <span class="esc-seq" title="non-wikiword">McNinja</span></strong>, <em><a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Webcomic/TheAdventuresOfDrMcNinja" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Webcomic/TheAdventuresOfDrMcNinja" data-format="V2ViY29taWMvVGhlQWR2ZW50dXJlc09mRHJNY05pbmph">The Adventures of Dr. McNinja</a></em>
</div></div><p></p><p>A swordsman strikes an opponent or other object with a mighty blow. At first, the strike appears to have done nothing and the person or thing looks perfectly intact. A few seconds later, though, the top half of the object begins to slide off the bottom half: through <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SuperStrength" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SuperStrength" data-format="W1tTdXBlclN0cmVuZ3RoIGdyZWF0IHN0cmVuZ3RoXV0=">great strength</a>, <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/MasterSwordsman" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/MasterSwordsman" data-format="W1tNYXN0ZXJTd29yZHNtYW4gZ3JlYXQgc2tpbGxdXQ==">great skill</a>, an <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/AbsurdlySharpBlade" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/AbsurdlySharpBlade" data-format="QWJzdXJkbHlTaGFycEJsYWRl">Absurdly Sharp Blade</a>, or the involvement of some kind of magic or <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/AppliedPhlebotinum" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/AppliedPhlebotinum" data-format="QXBwbGllZFBobGVib3RpbnVt">Applied Phlebotinum</a>, the sword has made a cut <em>so</em> clean that the object stays together until acted upon by an outside force, such as gravity, a gust of wind, or the victim trying to use their body normally. The initial seam created by the cut might not even be visible to the the naked eye: if it's a person their clothes may look intact, and the wound will not start to open up or bleed until it's revealed to the audience.
</p><p>A person thus unwittingly <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/HalfTheManHeUsedToBe" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/HalfTheManHeUsedToBe" data-format="W1tIYWxmVGhlTWFuSGVVc2VkVG9CZSBjdXQgaW4gaGFsZl1d">cut in half</a> may feel fine at first and laugh at their attacker for missing, until the moment of <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/OhCrap" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/OhCrap" data-format="W1tPaENyYXAgc2hvY2tlZCByZWFsaXphdGlvbl1d">shocked realization</a> when the two halves of their body slide apart and possibly spout <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/HighPressureBlood" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/HighPressureBlood" data-format="SGlnaFByZXNzdXJlQmxvb2Q=">High-Pressure Blood</a>. Optionally, the person who delivered the fatal blow might say "<a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/YouAreAlreadyDead" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/YouAreAlreadyDead" data-format="WW91QXJlQWxyZWFkeURlYWQ=">You Are Already Dead</a>" and/or finish sheathing their sword with an audible "click" as the cue for their foe to <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/DelayedCausality" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/DelayedCausality" data-format="W1tEZWxheWVkQ2F1c2FsaXR5IHN1ZGRlbmx5IGZhbGwgdG8gcGllY2VzXV0=">suddenly fall to pieces</a>.
</p><p>This trope name comes from the fact that in Japanese media, which furnishes numerous examples, the go-to method of inflicting it on a person is a diagonal downwards strike from shoulder to opposite hip. Please don't take the name too literally, though: a cut that's vertical, horizontal, or indeed any angle qualifies here as long as the effect of the cut is delayed. Conversely, a cut that literally follows a diagonal path but causes immediately visible damage or disassembly is <em>not</em> an example. Something might count as a downplayed case if the severing is immediately obvious, but still causes less of a structural collapse than expected: for example, if a person is instantly killed by beheading, but the head is moved so little by the blow that it remains balanced on top of the neck.
</p><p>This trope has a lot of <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/ArtisticLicensePhysics" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/ArtisticLicensePhysics" data-format="QXJ0aXN0aWNMaWNlbnNlUGh5c2ljcw==">Artistic License – Physics</a> and sometimes <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/ArtisticLicenseBiology" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/ArtisticLicenseBiology" data-format="QXJ0aXN0aWNMaWNlbnNlQmlvbG9neQ==">Artistic License – Biology</a> associated with it. For example, as long as the edge is sharp enough the actual thickness of the blade is totally ignored. A <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/BFS" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/BFS" data-format="e3tCRlN9fQ==">BFS</a> several centimeters thick can leave a cut as invisibly thin as monomolecular <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/RazorFloss" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/RazorFloss" data-format="UmF6b3JGbG9zcw==">Razor Floss</a>, even though logically it would have to displace a lot of material in order to pass through the object. Likewise, the actual depth of the object that's being sliced never affects the outcome of this move. It's possible to cut all the way through items whose thickness greatly exceeds the length of the swordsman's blade, such as cars, giant sequoias, or in extreme cases entire <em>buildings</em>. See the <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Analysis/DiagonalCut" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Analysis/DiagonalCut" data-format="W1tBbmFseXNpcy9EaWFnb25hbEN1dCBBbmFseXNpcyBzZWN0aW9uXV0=">Analysis section</a> for a discussion of the mechanics.
</p><p>The Diagonal Cut frequently happens in a <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SingleStrokeBattle" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SingleStrokeBattle" data-format="U2luZ2xlU3Ryb2tlQmF0dGxl">Single-Stroke Battle</a> with blades, although it also happens to inanimate scenery, especially if a warrior receives an <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/AbsurdlySharpBlade" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/AbsurdlySharpBlade" data-format="QWJzdXJkbHlTaGFycEJsYWRl">Absurdly Sharp Blade</a> and decides to test it on whatever target comes to hand. A regular <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/CleanCut" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/CleanCut" data-format="Q2xlYW5DdXQ=">Clean Cut</a> is when you have an object neatly sliced apart <em>without</em> the delayed reaction. Razor Floss and other <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SharpenedToASingleAtom" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SharpenedToASingleAtom" data-format="U2hhcnBlbmVkVG9BU2luZ2xlQXRvbQ==">Sharpened to a Single Atom</a> weapons tend to deliver a Diagonal Cut once per show for extra shock value and<span class="esc-seq" title="non-wikiword">/</span>or <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/RuleOfCool" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/RuleOfCool" data-format="W1tSdWxlT2ZDb29sIGJvbnVzIGF3ZXNvbWVuZXNzXV0=">bonus awesomeness</a>, with <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/CleanCut" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/CleanCut" data-format="e3tDbGVhbiBDdXR9fXM=">Clean Cuts</a> used the rest of the time.
</p><p>For a plentiful source of video examples, check out this <a class="urllink" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o059P5FHw-4">"Cut/Slide" reel<img src="https://static.tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pub/external_link.gif" height="12" width="12" style="border:none;"></a> compiling many clips of the diagonal cut being inflicted on people in action and horror films. Be warned, however: four minutes of people getting sliced up and then slowly falling apart while still conscious can be pretty <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Squick" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Squick" data-format="W1t7e1NxdWlja319IHN0b21hY2gtdHVybmluZ11d">stomach-turning</a>. However, it may also be a <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Narm" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Narm" data-format="W1t7e05hcm19fSBoaWxhcmlvdXNdXQ==">hilarious</a> demonstration of how this trope is <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SpecialEffectsFailure" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/SpecialEffectsFailure" data-format="W1tTcGVjaWFsRWZmZWN0c0ZhaWx1cmUgaGFyZGVyIHRvIHNob3cgY29udmluY2luZ2x5XV0=">harder to show convincingly</a> in live action than in animation. Further, it shows that something used too often can <a class="twikilink" href="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Administrivia/TropesAreTools" title="/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Administrivia/TropesAreTools" data-format="W1tBZG1pbmlzdHJpdmlhL1Ryb3Blc0FyZVRvb2xzIGxvc2UgaXRzIGVmZmVjdCB2ZXJ5IHF1aWNrbHldXQ==">lose its effect very quickly</a>.
</p><hr data-format="——">

<script>
// correct incorrect URL capitalization on article pages
if(tvtropes_config.universal_page_type == 'Article'){
    // Extract the groupname and title from the URL
    var url = window.location.href;
    var hash = window.location.hash; // Preserve the hash/fragment
    
    var url_parts = url.split('#')[0].split('/'); // Remove hash before splitting
    var title = url_parts[url_parts.length - 1];
    var groupname = url_parts[url_parts.length - 2];

    // Correct groupname and title from PHP (also works on new/non-existing pages)
    var correct_groupname = 'Main';
    var correct_title = 'DiagonalCut';

    // Check if they are different (case-sensitive comparison)
    if (groupname !== correct_groupname || title !== correct_title) {
        // Construct the corrected URL
        var correctedUrl = url_parts.slice(0, -2).join('/') + '/' + correct_groupname + '/' + correct_title;
        
        // Add the hash back if it exists
        if (hash) {
            correctedUrl += hash;
        }

        // Update the browser URL without reloading the page
        window.history.replaceState(null, '', correctedUrl);
    }
}

function insert_ad(adCount, paragraph, adName, folder = 0, logged_in){

        var ad_count = adCount < 10 ? "0"+adCount : adCount;
        var inside_folder = folder ? "1" : "0";
        var screen_width = document.body.clientWidth;
        var resolution = (screen_width >= 769 && screen_width <= 993) ? "769_993" : screen_width;

        // Create element for ad unit
        var adUnit = document.createElement('div');
        adUnit.setAttribute("class", `htlad-${adName} ${adName}`);
        adUnit.setAttribute("id", `${adName}_${adCount}`);
        adUnit.setAttribute("data-targeting", `{"slot_number": "${ad_count}", "in_folder": "${inside_folder}", "resolution": "${resolution}"}`);

        // create element for subscribe link
        var subscribeWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        subscribeWrapper.setAttribute("class", "ad-caption-subscribe-wrapper");
        var subscribeLink = document.createElement('a');
        subscribeLink.setAttribute("href", "/pmwiki/ad-free-subscribe.php");
        subscribeLink.setAttribute("class", "ad-caption-subscribe");

        // only include this for non-users
        if(logged_in == false) {
            subscribeLink.innerHTML = `<span class="ad-caption-text">Tired of seeing ads? </span><span class="ad-caption-link">Subscribe!</span>`;
        }

        // Add Advertisement label
        var adLabel = document.createElement("span");
        adLabel.innerHTML = "Advertisement:"
        adLabel.setAttribute("class","ad-caption");

        var adWrapper = document.createElement("div");
        adWrapper.setAttribute("class","tvtropes-ad-unit mobile-fad square_fad mobile_unit_scroll");
        adWrapper.setAttribute("id","mobile_"+adCount);

        // Merge all pieces
        adWrapper.appendChild(adLabel);
        adWrapper.appendChild(adUnit);
        adWrapper.appendChild(subscribeWrapper);
        subscribeWrapper.appendChild(subscribeLink);

        // Insert adWrapper right after the paragraph
        paragraph.parentNode.insertBefore(adWrapper, paragraph.nextSibling);

        // Insert subscribeWrapper right after adWrapper (as its sibling)
        paragraph.parentNode.insertBefore(subscribeWrapper, adWrapper.nextSibling);

        // for getting correct ad count even when ones are deleted
        globalAdInsertionCount++;
}

function insert_ads_in_content(folder = 0, totalAdsCount = 0, pHeight = 0) {

    if(folder) var node = folder.firstElementChild; // Get the first traversable element of the folder
    else var node = document.getElementById("main-article").firstElementChild;

    var pCount = 0;
    var adCount = totalAdsCount + 1;
    var nodeCount = 0;
    var nodeLevel = 0;
    var x = 0;

    //loop through elements of content
    while(x<300) {
        x++; nodeCount++;

        //traverse to the next element (if exists)
        if(nodeCount>1) {
            if(!node.nextElementSibling) {
                console.log('adparser: no next element');

                if(nodeLevel>0) {
                    nodeLevel--;
                    node = node.parentElement;
                    console.log('adparser: we were down a level, go back up ('+nodeLevel+')');
                    continue;
                }
                else {
                    break; 
                }
            }

            node = node.nextElementSibling;
        }


        //skip inserted ads or empty nodes
        if(!node || node==="null" || typeof node !== "object") continue;
        if(!node.offsetHeight || node.offsetHeight==0) continue;
        if(node.className && node.className.includes('tvtropes-ad-unit')) continue;

        //skip if image block that has a caption after it (NEW: ALWAYS SKIP THE IMAGE BLOCK)
        if(node.className && node.className.includes('quoteright')) {
            // if(node.nextElementSibling && node.nextElementSibling.className && node.nextElementSibling.className.includes('acaptionright')) {
                pHeight += node.offsetHeight;
                continue;
            // }
        } 

        //if very large element, loop through elements inside
        if(node.offsetHeight>700 && node.firstElementChild) {
            nodeLevel++;
            console.log('adparser: traverse through large element='+node.nodeName+', height='+node.offsetHeight+' level='+nodeLevel);
            node = node.firstElementChild;
            nodeCount = 0;
            continue;
        }

        // Skip if after a folder label or if the current node is a folder label itself
        if ((node.previousElementSibling && node.previousElementSibling.className && node.previousElementSibling.className.includes("folderlabel")) || (node.className && node.className.includes("folderlabel"))) {
            console.log('adparser: skipping ad insertion related to folder label');
            if (!node.className || !node.className.includes("folderlabel")) { // If it's not the folder label itself, skip the insertion
                continue;
            } else {
                pHeight += node.offsetHeight; // If it is the folder label, just add its height to pHeight and continue
                continue;
            }
        }

        //paragraph counter
        if(node.nodeName=="P") pCount++;

        //add height of node to counter
        pHeight += node.offsetHeight;

        //add margin of node to counter if available
        try {
            var nodeStyle = getComputedStyle(node);
            if(nodeStyle.marginTop && parseInt(nodeStyle.marginTop)>0) pHeight+=parseInt(nodeStyle.marginTop);
            if(nodeStyle.marginBottom && parseInt(nodeStyle.marginBottom)>0) pHeight+=parseInt(nodeStyle.marginBottom);
            //console.log(nodeStyle.marginTop+','+nodeStyle.marginBottom);
        } catch(e) { }

        //debug logging
        console.log('adparser: name='+node.nodeName+', height='+node.offsetHeight+' =>'+pHeight);
        //console.log(node.className);

        // check if user is logged in
        var logged_in = 0;

        // Calculate the required height based on the user's logged-in status or ad count
        var requiredHeight           = globalAdInsertionCount > 15 ? 1500 : 1100;
        if(logged_in) requiredHeight = 2250;

        // only inserts an ad if the total height and paragraph count conditions are met
        if ((adCount === 1 && pCount >= 1 && pHeight >= 400) || pHeight >= requiredHeight) {
            // Check existing ad positions and compare with the item about to be inserted after
            var ads = document.querySelectorAll('.tvtropes-ad-unit');
            var nodeBottomPosition = node.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + window.scrollY; // Get bottom position of current node
            var canInsertAd = true; // Flag to track if we can insert an ad

            ads.forEach(function (ad) {
                var adTop = ad.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
                var adBottom = ad.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + window.scrollY;

                // Ensure the new ad is at least requiredHeight away from any existing ads
                if (Math.abs(nodeBottomPosition - adTop) < requiredHeight || Math.abs(nodeBottomPosition - adBottom) < requiredHeight) {
                    canInsertAd = false;
                    console.log('adparser: cannot insert ad, not enough space between ads.');
                }
            });
            // If we can't insert an ad, skip to the next node
            if(!canInsertAd) continue;

            // after 50 ads, stop inserting. Or after 20 ads if the user is logged in
            if ((adCount > 50 || (adCount > 20 && logged_in))) {
                break;
            }

            console.log('adparser: insert ad '+adCount);
            insert_ad(adCount, node, "tvtropes_m_incontent_dynamic", folder, logged_in);
            adCount++;
            pHeight = 0;
            pCount = 0;
        }
    }

    //insert one at end if room
    var maxpHeight = 1100; if(logged_in) maxpHeight=1500;
    if(pHeight>=maxpHeight && folder==0) {
        console.log('adparser: insert ad');

        insert_ad(adCount, document.getElementById("main-article").lastElementChild, "tvtropes_m_incontent_dynamic", logged_in);
    }

    // delete ads after the 8th one to reduce load times
    BCLighthouseTag.cmd.push(function() {
        googletag.cmd.push(function() {
            googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRequested', function(event) {
                const slot = event.slot;
                const slotName = slot.getAdUnitPath().split('/').pop() || slot.getAdUnitPath();

                if(slotName === 'tvtropes_m_incontent_dynamic') {
                    const slotNumber = parseInt(slot.getTargeting('slot_number')[0]);
                    console.log(slotName+' = '+slotNumber);

                    // Determine the ad slot that needs to be deleted.
                    const adNumberToDelete = slotNumber - 8;

                    if(adNumberToDelete > 0) {
                        const adToDelete = document.getElementById(`mobile_${adNumberToDelete}`);
                        if(adToDelete) {
                            var adHeight = window.pageYOffset + adToDelete.getBoundingClientRect().top;
                            var windowHeight = window.scrollY;

                            // Check if the ad element exists and is above the current viewport (above the fold).
                            if (adHeight < windowHeight) {
                                console.log('ad delete = '+adNumberToDelete);
                                adToDelete.remove(); 
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    });

    // return pHeight 
    return pHeight;
}

if(1 && (document.body.clientWidth && document.body.clientWidth<=993) ) {
    insert_ads_in_content();
}
</script>
